en: Black-and-white postcard showing a large wooden house with a gambrel-style roof set amid trees and curved gravel paths. The building stands on a small rise with stone foundation walls and appears to be part of a school campus or institutional grounds. In the foreground are lawns, young trees, and a large mature tree to the right. Printed caption text runs along the bottom edge, and a small publisher's logo appears in the lower right corner.
